Name: Super coffee
Author: XyOxAnX
Description:
Add new drinks based on coffee.

1 - Coffee with milk, The calcium in milk makes your bones stronger, so in addition to giving you speed it gives you armor. You can buy the recipe and drink from Gus and then prepare it in the kitchen with 1 milk and 1 Coffee.

2 - The Super coffee, it is 3 times more powerful than the Triple Shot Espresso. You can buy the recipe and drink from Gus and then prepare it in the kitchen with 3 Triple Shot Espresso.

---How to install the mod---

1 - Make sure you have SMAPI installed and that Json Assets are in the StardewValley/Mods folder.

2 - Unzip the file Super cafe.zip in the StardewValley/Mods folder.


This mod is available only for SMAPI 3.18.3 and Json Assets 1.10.14
Using a different version of those 2 files can cause problems.
